Iconic Chipware. It holds one person's full personality and memories, streamed into a digital copy by an Arasaka program - a procedure so far out of reach it wants Reputation Rank 9, a million eurodollars, and Arasaka's goodwill. Slotted into a shard slot, that copy can be talked to as a digital avatar only the user sees, whether that's a dead character or whoever else the GM decides lives on the chip. The 1.0 does nothing else.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
